title: vaporize CLI install reports success without verifying the executable actually landed (silent 'removed but not replaced')
description: installCLI() (sources/vaporize-cli/main.swift) runs SwiftCLIInstaller.run() (which delegates to `swift package experimental-install`) and then publishInstalledCLI() to symlink into the domain tree — but it NEVER verifies that an executable actually landed at the flat install path (~/.swiftpm/bin/<product>). `experimental-install` removes any prior binary before writing the new one; if the copy step aborts/fails, the destination is left MISSING while the command still returns success. Vaporize then reports a successful build/install with no installed tool. This is the root cause of BUG-SAVEPOINT-CLI-MISSING-FROM-SWIFTPM-BIN-2026-07-08: savepoint.cli@kura-org.clia.sh regressed to a lone .bak with no live binary, undetected until next use (3 weeks later).
impact: Violates the substrate axiom [[tooling-silent-fallback-to-wrong-state-not-error-loud]]: a tool that cannot do the thing must fail loudly. A silent install failure that reports success is exactly the drift class the axiom forbids.

resolution.fix: Added a post-install presence check in installCLI() immediately after SwiftCLIInstaller.run(): guard FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: installedCLIPath(product:)) else { throw ValidationError(...) }. Reuses the existing loud ValidationError primitive. Now a build/install that leaves the destination missing fails loudly instead of reporting success.

items: installApp() (.app path) made ATOMIC: copy to a staged sibling on the same volume, then swap via replaceItemAt (replace) or moveItem (fresh) — eliminates the remove-then-copy window entirely, plus a loud post-install presence check (new InstallerError.installVerificationFailed). This is the atomic upgrade the CLI path could not get (SwiftPM's `experimental-install` owns the CLI copy, so installCLI only verifies after; the .app path is vaporize-owned so it gets true atomicity).

Positive per-install presence confirmation added to installCLI(): prints 'vaporize: verified <product> installed at <path>' on success — a suite reinstall (one invocation per product) emits one confirmation each, so a single missing binary surfaces immediately (the visibility half of the multi-binary summary).
Compile verified (swift build exit 0); fully-hardened vaporize release-installed live.

furtherHardening: Full multi-product BATCH verify surface: a `vaporize verify --products a,b,c` subcommand (or multi `--product` support) that checks + reports presence across a named set in ONE invocation, so the savepoint suite (4 products, currently 4 separate calls) can be verified as a set. Distinct feature needing its own design; per-install confirmation (landed above) is the interim.

relatedTypedRecords.t: The downstream symptom: savepoint.cli missing (lone .bak); root-caused to this vaporize install gap.
